title: Ziggurat
subtitle: PURE GEOMETRY · FOUR LAYERS
philosophy: Four rounded bars stacked bottom-up, each shorter than the one below: H (Infrastructure) is the widest foundation, I (Intelligence) the narrowest crown. Left-aligned so the silhouette reads as growth, not a monument. The order P → D → I of the DX-OS method is literally the shape.

title: Cycle
subtitle: DOT MATRIX · SIX STAGES
philosophy: Six dots on an empty ring: measure, interview, plan, apply, verify, handbook. The first stage is heavier because everything starts with measuring; the hollow centre is the organisation the pipeline keeps circling back to (re-measure).

title: Strike
subtitle: LINE SYSTEM · THE HAMMER
philosophy: Four heavy horizontal strokes are the layers; a single diagonal cut of negative space runs through them like one hammer blow on the anvil. The forge does not add material, it shapes what is already there.

title: Forge F
subtitle: LETTER · GATED LAYER
philosophy: A geometric F built from three layer bars on one stem, plus a fourth bar that is not attached yet. That detached bar is the Intelligence layer: present in every plan, applied only when the organisation's maturity gate opens. The letter and the method are the same drawing.

title: Compile
subtitle: DOTS + GEOMETRY · INPUT TO OUTPUT
philosophy: Scattered dots on the left are the organisation as it is: people, habits, spreadsheets. They pass through one solid bar, the compiler, and come out as four aligned layers. Assembly line in one glance: chaos, forge, order.

title: Diamond Loop
subtitle: LINE + GEOMETRY · THE TARGET SHAPE
philosophy: An open ring with an arrowhead is the measure-again loop; the solid diamond in the centre is the book's ideal radar shape, kim cương, where H is small and P, D, I are balanced. Every run of DX-Forge is one lap toward the diamond.
